voices.title: This was supposed to be the easy part of the schedule. Dropping 2 to the Athletics, with Guerrero batting 3rd to kill rallies, tied for 2nd in MLB with 19 GIDP. Team played best while he was injured last month.
reply_texts: How is it only 19? Seems like he hits into one every game.

voices.source: MLB公式ハイライトのコメント
